prose: Super Micro reported first-quarter revenue up 298% year over year to $19.95 billion, against $16.39 billion expected, and forecast second-quarter revenue above analyst estimates, per Reuters. Demand for AI-optimized servers drove sales and the stock rose more than 7% after hours.
highlights: SMCI Q1 revenue up 298% to $19.95B vs $16.39B estimate
Q2 forecast above estimates; stock up 7%+ after hours
